definition: Gato is a deep neural network for a range of complex tasks that exhibits multimodality.
details: It can perform tasks such as engaging in a dialogue, playing video games, controlling a robot arm to stack blocks, and more.

explainer.lead: Gato is a multimodal deep neural network developed by DeepMind to handle many kinds of complex tasks with one system. It can converse, play video games, and control a robot arm to stack blocks, illustrating how capabilities that are often built separately can be brought together.

tiers.eli5: Gato is like one helper learning several different jobs instead of a separate helper for each job. It can chat, play video games, and guide a robot arm to stack blocks. Its special feature is that the same kind of system can work with these different tasks.
tiers.practitioner: Gato is applied as a single multimodal model across dialogue, game-playing, and robotic-control tasks rather than as a separate model for each. Its outputs must match the task, such as a conversational response or a robot-control command. A key pitfall is assuming that breadth across tasks implies expertise or reliability in every task.
tiers.paperLevel: Gato is a deep neural network with multimodal behavior across a range of complex tasks, expressible schematically as y = f(x, t), where t identifies the task setting and y is the corresponding response or control output. Demonstrated task settings include dialogue, video-game play, and robotic block stacking.

usedIn.name: Video games
usedIn.detail: Plays games as one of its task settings.

usedIn.name: Robotic manipulation
usedIn.detail: Controls a robot arm to stack blocks.

flow: Provide an input from a supported task.
Process it with the Gato neural network.
Produce the appropriate response or action.
explainer.origin: Gato was developed by DeepMind as a multimodal deep neural network for a range of complex tasks.
explainer.whyItMatters: Gato shows that one neural network can span conversation, game play, and physical robot control. This makes it a useful example of multimodal, general-purpose model design.

diagram.caption: Different task inputs pass through Gato and lead to a response or action appropriate to the task.
